description: Power Cement Limited, formerly Al-Abbas Cement Limited, was acquired in 2010 by the Arif Habib Group and is engaged in the manufacturing, marketing and sale of cement from a plant at Motorway M9, Nooriabad, Sindh. Its production lines have a nameplate clinker capacity of 10,700 tons per day (3.21 million tons a year), with cement production capacity of 3.37 million tons annually, and it exports clinker and cement to destinations including the Middle East, Sri Lanka, East and West Africa, the United Kingdom and the United States.
